title: journey.toml, read as TOML: what a journey is and where each stage stands
description: For each stage: by is reply (a chat's reply, not yet accepted) or accept (a person looked); inputs the sha256 of each input when the output was made (taken when its prompt was rendered, for a reply); output the sha256 of the output then; prompt the brief it answered ({id, version, hash}). rendered holds a prompt shown and not yet answered, per part (all, or era-N). status compares these with the files now and reruns nothing.

rule.description: The panel's rule, set by new: a pick needs `yes` yes votes of `of` judges, and with veto one judge can stop it. A panel reply can't change it.

tracks.description: The playlist's entries as Artist - Title, beside songs, for the prompts.
